g.text: 20c · Grace recovery and stolen token replay protection
Retry refresh with previous token and stable request ID
Forward retry request with request ID
Query rotated token and check grace-period recovery window
Token was recently rotated under matching request ID
Re-issue replacement token pair without penalty
Attempt refresh with expired or previously consumed token
Query token hash and check revocation status
Token is revoked outside recovery window (Replay detected!)
Emergency security action: Revoke all active sessions for user
Client clears local session credentials and redirects user to login
